title: Cox proportional-hazards regression
biology: Seedling death times are related to protective dose and temperature.
other_examples: Dose effects on time to infection
question: Does dose alter death hazard after accounting for temperature?
null: The dose coefficient is zero: the adjusted hazard ratio per dose unit is one.
assumptions: Suitable covariate effects and censoring mechanism
A constant hazard ratio for ordinary coefficients
Independent seedlings; model dependence if present
parametric: Allow time-varying effects or justified strata
An AFT model targets a survival-time ratio
nonparametric: Cox leaves the baseline hazard unspecified
Log-rank supports a simpler group comparison

plot_args.note: Hold temperature fixed while varying dose
Choose whether uncertainty bands are drawn

practice: Explain why a hazard ratio of 0.6 does not mean 60% as many seedlings survive.
code_simulate:
set.seed(2112)
d <- data.frame(seedling = 1:180, dose = runif(180, 0, 3),
                temperature = rnorm(180, 25, 2))
rate <- exp(log(.035) - .45 * d$dose + .12 * (d$temperature - 25))
event_time <- rexp(180, rate = rate)
follow_up <- runif(180, 45, 100)
d$days <- pmin(event_time, follow_up)
d$event <- as.integer(event_time <= follow_up)
write.csv(d, file.path(output_dir, "data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
code_plot:
par(mar = c(5, 5, 2, 1), las = 1, bty = "l", cex = 1.15)
plot(curves, col = c("#246A73", "#73969B", "#B7663E"), lwd = 2.5,
     conf.int = FALSE, xlab = "Days since exposure",
     ylab = "Fitted survival probability")
legend("topright", c("Dose 0", "Dose 1.5", "Dose 3"), lty = 1, lwd = 2.5,
       col = c("#246A73", "#73969B", "#B7663E"), bty = "n")
mtext("Fitted curves at 25°C", side = 3, line = .1, adj = 0)
code_analysis:
fit <- survival::coxph(survival::Surv(days, event) ~ dose + temperature,
                       data = d, x = TRUE)
summary(fit)
ph_check <- survival::cox.zph(fit)
hazard_ci <- exp(confint(fit)["dose", ])
generating_model: 180 seedlings have dose Uniform(0, 3) and temperature Normal(25, 2²)°C. Conditional event times are exponential with rate exp(log(0.035) − 0.45 × dose + 0.12 × (temperature − 25)). Independent censoring times are Uniform(45, 100) days. Save the minimum time and event indicator without rounding.
generating_truth: The adjusted hazard ratio per dose unit is exp(−0.45) ≈ 0.638; per °C it is exp(0.12) ≈ 1.127. The dose null is false and proportional hazards holds in the generating model.
teaching_point: A hazard ratio compares instantaneous event risk among individuals still at risk.
